name: El Robledo (Spain)
description: Vertically divided white and green, the white charged with the crowned municipal arms of El Robledo (an oak, a lion, an eagle and a river).
history: Municipal flag of El Robledo; Spanish municipal flags are approved by the municipal council and the autonomous community and published in the regional official gazette.

features.role: El Robledo arms — oak, lion, eagle and river
